_readme: The example decks the landing page shows, in gallery order. The first is the hero. name: the directory under examples/ and the path under /demo/. startSlide: the 1-based slide where the poster, the loop and the live deck start (the first story slide when omitted). startBeat: the 0-based step on that slide (0 when omitted). provenance: agent (drafted by Claude Code, then edited), talk (one of the talks Decks was extracted from), template or hand. run: the recorded agent run behind an agent deck, a fixture in fixtures/ written by scripts/excerpt-run.mjs, and setup: repo (this repository's own agent setup) or init (a fresh project set up with decks init). edits: either from (the commit before the edit: the raw agent output, plus any plumbing commit) and to (the commit with the edit), or commits (the edit commits only, each diffed against its parent, so a plumbing commit between them is left out), and by (hand, or claude when a second Claude Code session made the edit); scripts/edits.mjs diffs from..to into fixtures/examples/<name>.edits.json. loop: true when make demo captures a hero loop into public/loops/. featured: short label and hint for the featured example picker. attribution: excerpt source label and optional public URL. Generated posters include 640/1280/1920 widths.
